caption: The drawing depicts a segment of a brick arch with a decorative keystone at the center. The arch is constructed of reddish-brown bricks that are arranged in a curved formation, radiating out from the keystone at the apex. The keystone is a light, stone-like color and features a carved relief with a symmetrical design, possibly representing a stylized plant or leaf. Above the arch, there are several rows of grey stone blocks that suggest part of a wall or structure. The background is an off-white or light beige color with no additional objects or details, leaving the focus solely on the brick arch segment and its keystone. The artist's signature, "RAYMONDE L. NICOLLE," is written in small letters to the right of the central figure.
title: Keystone
